title: Website-landlord niches: spray foam / crime-scene cleanup
one_liner: Build city+service SEO sites in under-webbed urgent niches (spray foam, crime-scene cleanup, autoglass); rent call-forwarding leads monthly after a free proof week.
why_agent_runnable: SERP weakness scans, city/service site drafts, operator outreach, and call-log reporting are agent-native. Brandon gates domain spend, publish, partner deals, and send.

ops_steps.title: Stale-SERP niche×city scan
ops_steps.detail: Search spray foam / crime-scene cleanup / autoglass + cities; flag markets where top results are outdated directories.

ops_steps.title: Brandon niche×city pick
ops_steps.detail: Choose first 1-2 city+service pairs and max domain/hosting budget.

ops_steps.title: Site build pack
ops_steps.detail: Draft thin-but-credible city+service sites with call tracking placeholders — staging only.

ops_steps.title: Operator shortlist
ops_steps.detail: Find local operators who can fulfill; draft free-week proof + monthly rent pitch.

ops_steps.title: Publish + call-track money gate
ops_steps.detail: Approve domains, go-live, call tracking spend, and outreach identity.

ops_steps.title: Proof week + rent close
ops_steps.detail: Forward calls during free week; draft rent agreement + invoice; Brandon send/pay gates.

ops_steps.title: Portfolio expand or kill
ops_steps.detail: If rent converts, clone next city; kill sites with no qualified call volume in 45 days.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.site_build_cost_usd: domain/hosting tens–low hundreds; time is main cost
unit_economics_sketch.monthly_rent_framing: flat monthly to operator after free proof week (negotiated)
unit_economics_sketch.call_tracking_usd_mo: typically low tens to low hundreds
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: Works only if SERP is weak and operator closes. Source $100k/mo anecdote is not a Brandon target. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
